name: OI-flush capitulation V-bounce (15m spot long the exhausted cascade)
rationale: MECHANISM: a sharp OI collapse WHILE price is falling is the fingerprint of forced deleveraging — margin calls close over-levered longs en masse (Oct-2025: 70% of $19B liquidated in 40 min). Once the clustered liquidation ladder is consumed, the marginal FORCED seller is gone and price snaps back V-shaped within hours. The counterparty is a liquidation engine / market-maker dumping into thin books at any price — a structurally price-INSENSITIVE, non-economic seller you buy from at a forced discount, so the edge persists (the flush is self-terminating, not an arbable level). SPOT long on 15m to catch the exhaustion instant with no perp/funding leg. Entry: open_interest cross_down through a fitted normalized floor (the flush) AND ret_Nd below a negative floor (price is FALLING, disambiguating capitulation from a deleverage-rally) AND rsi below an oversold floor (washout, not orderly bleed) AND vol_realized above a floor (the violent regime where cascades actually exhaust). DISCONFIRMER: drop the open_interest arm and keep only rsi-oversold + ret_Nd-down — if the deflated Sharpe is matched, OI adds nothing and this is generic oversold-bounce; second, flip ret_Nd-down to ret_Nd-UP — if the long still profits, OI is a pure price-proxy and the sign is incoherent. Must clear ~20bps Binance-spot round-trip net.
catalyst: OI cross_down flush while price falls into an oversold washout — a forced-seller exhaustion V
